understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces can be selected by clicking them or their reachable positions, then moved with directional actions or clicks to destinations. Movement is constrained by obstacles and walls; blocked moves have no effect but consume a step. Pieces may be pushed when movement allows it, though walls and obstacles prevent pushing or passage. Multiple pieces and goals require coordinating all pieces onto goals at the same time.
